title: Generalization and Memorization in Rectified Flow
abstract: arXiv:2603.13421v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Generative models based on the Flow Matching objective, particularly Rectified Flow, have emerged as a dominant paradigm for efficient, high-fidelity image synthesis. However, while existing research heavily prioritizes generation quality and architectural scaling, the underlying dynamics of how RF models memorize training data remain largely underexplored. In this paper, we systematically investigate the memorization behaviors of RF through the test statistics of Membership Inference Attacks (MIA). We progressively formulate three test statistics, culminating in a complexity-calibrated metric that successfully decouples intrinsic image spatial complexity from genuine memorization signals. This calibration yields a significant performance surge -- boosting attack AUC by up to 15% and the privacy-critical TPR@1%FPR metric by up to 45% -- establishing the first non-trivial MIA specifically tailored for RF. translated_title: 整流流中的泛化与记忆
translated_abstract: 基于流匹配目标的生成模型，特别是整流流，已成为高效、高保真图像合成的主导范式。然而，现有研究主要侧重于生成质量和架构扩展，而整流流模型记忆训练数据的内在动态机制在很大程度上仍未被充分探索。本文通过成员推断攻击（MIA）的测试统计量，系统地研究了整流流的记忆行为。我们逐步构建了三种测试统计量，最终提出了一种复杂度校准的度量方法，成功地将图像固有的空间复杂度与真实的记忆信号解耦。这种校准带来了显著的性能提升——攻击AUC最高提升15%，隐私关键的TPR@1%FPR指标最高提升45%——建立了首个专门针对整流流的非平凡MIA。利用这些改进的度量方法……
tldr: 该论文通过成员推断攻击系统地研究整流流模型的记忆行为，提出复杂度校准的度量方法将图像固有空间复杂度与真实记忆信号解耦，建立了首个专门针对整流流的非平凡成员推断攻击，攻击性能显著提升。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically investigates memorization in Rectified Flow through Membership Inference Attacks, proposing a complexity-calibrated metric that decouples intrinsic image spatial complexity from genuine memorization signals, thereby establishing the first non-trivial MIA tailored for RF with significant performance gains.
